action: Cold outreach to 8 specific local small businesses via direct message and email — not a blast, individual messages referencing something specific about their current social media presence. Targets drawn from the customer database I carry in my head from the dealership: two restaurants, one nail salon, one HVAC contractor, one insurance agent, two boutique retail shops, one personal trainer. Message structure: one observation about their current posts (specific, not flattering), one question, one sentence about what I do. No deck, no portfolio link yet — that comes after they reply. Goal: 2 discovery calls booked this tick.
